Class monitor duties
Lead the line the right way

Support our class monitor
Take turns to lead

Needs first, wants later
Save in my piggy bank

Return extra change
Never take money that is not mine

My body is mine
Shout and tell a trusted adult

Never follow strangers
Say my name only when safe

Shout for help
Know mummy's phone number

Screens need grown up time too
Tell adults what I see

Talk it out, walk it out
Agree the fair way

Recite my safety rules
Safety star awards
